zh_HK: 核心修復效率
全域防線：免疫核心持續修復加快。同名百分比只由防線環提供。
en: Global defense: accelerates continuous Immune Core repair. This percentage is supplied only by the Defense ring.

zh_HK: 固定塔位擴充
全域防線：可同時展開的固定炮台席次 +1，不是傷害百分比。
en: Global defense: increases simultaneous fixed-turret capacity by 1. Capacity is not a damage percentage.

zh_HK: 塔間支援鏈
2-1 匯合：修復與塔位連成支援鏈。規則解鎖，不再疊修復%。
en: 2-1 convergence: links repair and turret slots into a support chain. Unlocks a rule without stacking more repair percentage.

zh_HK: 路線干擾障壁
敵人沿入侵路線被輕微減速。與狀態化學緩速分開，數值較小。
en: Slightly slows enemies moving along invasion routes. This is separate from status-chemistry slow and has a smaller value.

zh_HK: 核心緊急護盾
核心生命低於閾值時展開一次護盾。一次性規則。
en: Deploys a one-use shield when Core health falls below its threshold.

zh_HK: 防守波次預備
每波開始前為核心與固定炮台預補一次耐久。
en: Restores some durability to the Core and fixed turrets before each wave begins.

zh_HK: 核心終極防線
3-1 匯合：護盾強化。不再疊加修復百分比。
en: 3-1 convergence: strengthens the shield without stacking another repair percentage.

zh_HK: 偵察範圍延伸
全域遠征：揭示距離 +6%。
en: Global expedition: increases reveal distance by 6%.

zh_HK: 迷霧預覽強化
未進入的感染區可預覽敵人族群。規則解鎖。
en: Allows a preview of enemy populations in infection zones before entry. Unlocks a rule.

zh_HK: 遠征節點解鎖
2-1 匯合：開放下一層遠征節點。不是視野%。
en: 2-1 convergence: opens the next layer of expedition nodes. This is not a vision percentage.

zh_HK: 邊疆建造資格
可在遠征格放置臨時固定席。
en: Allows temporary fixed positions to be placed on expedition tiles.

zh_HK: 遠征補給效率
遠征帶回資源 +6%。
en: Increases resources returned from expeditions by 6%.

zh_HK: 撤退窗口延長
強制撤退前的安全窗口延長。規則。
en: Extends the safe window before a forced retreat. Unlocks a rule.

zh_HK: 疆域終極擴張
3-1 匯合：再 +4% 遠征補給。不再疊視野。
en: 3-1 convergence: adds 4% expedition supply yield without stacking more vision.

zh_HK: 全體攻擊節奏
全域戰爭：全體攻速 +5%。攻速只從戰爭環來，機動環不再給攻速。
en: Global warfare: increases all attack speed by 5%. Attack speed comes from the War ring, not the Mobility ring.

zh_HK: 軍團橫向容量
全域戰爭：橫向軍團席次 +1。容量不是百分比，避免和攻速雙疊。
en: Global warfare: increases lateral army capacity by 1. Capacity is not a percentage and does not double-stack with attack speed.

zh_HK: 全域火力同步
2-1 匯合：再 +4% 攻速。合併點小於第一枝，避免越合越大。
en: 2-1 convergence: adds 4% attack speed. The merge bonus is smaller than the first branch.

zh_HK: 固定炮台射速
僅固定勤務 +4% 射速。與全體攻速分開計算。
en: Increases fire rate by 4% only while on fixed duty. Calculated separately from global attack speed.

zh_HK: 移動追擊節奏
僅移動勤務 +4% 攻速。與固定射速互斥加成。
en: Increases attack speed by 4% only while on mobile duty. Mutually exclusive with the fixed-duty bonus.

zh_HK: 技能冷卻壓縮
全體冷卻 −6%。走冷卻軸，不再疊攻速。
en: Reduces all skill cooldowns by 6%. This follows the cooldown axis instead of stacking attack speed.

zh_HK: 全面戰爭終極戰術
3-1 匯合：再 +4% 攻速。冷卻已在上一枝，終局不雙疊。
en: 3-1 convergence: adds 4% attack speed. Cooldown is handled by the prior branch and is not stacked here.

zh_HK: 全體移動節奏
全域機動：移速 +6%。移速只從機動環來。
en: Global mobility: increases movement speed by 6%. Movement speed comes only from the Mobility ring.

zh_HK: 快速部署通道
部署前搖縮短 8%。不是攻速。
en: Reduces deployment wind-up by 8%. This is not attack speed.

zh_HK: 跨區域轉移
2-1 匯合：解鎖跨區轉移規則，不再疊移速%。
en: 2-1 convergence: unlocks cross-region transfer without stacking more movement speed.

zh_HK: 移動單位耐久
移動勤務生命 +6%。生存軸，不是輸出。
en: Increases mobile-duty health by 6%. This is survivability, not damage output.

zh_HK: 機動協同增幅
近距離移動單位互相獲得編隊加成。規則解鎖，不含攻速。
en: Nearby mobile units grant each other a formation bonus. Unlocks a rule without attack speed.

zh_HK: 撤退掩護編隊
撤退時移動單位為核心提供短暫掩護射擊。
en: Mobile units provide brief covering fire for the Core during retreat.

zh_HK: 機動終極編隊
3-1 匯合：再 +4% 移速。不把攻速塞進機動終局。
en: 3-1 convergence: adds 4% movement speed without placing attack speed in the Mobility capstone.

zh_HK: 雙家族相性基礎
全域融合：雙家族相性研究消耗略降。不直接加傷害。
en: Global fusion: slightly lowers dual-family affinity research costs without directly increasing damage.

zh_HK: 融合效率增幅
融合核心轉換效率 +6%。
en: Increases Fusion Core conversion efficiency by 6%.

zh_HK: 三融合資格預備
2-1 匯合：開放三融合資格檢查，不是輸出%。
en: 2-1 convergence: opens triple-fusion qualification checks. This is not an output percentage.

zh_HK: 傳承特質保留
融合後保留更多來源家族被動。規則解鎖。
en: Preserves more passive traits from source families after fusion. Unlocks a rule.

zh_HK: 融合核心回收
替換融合時退回 20% 融合核心。
en: Refunds 20% of Fusion Cores when replacing a fusion.

zh_HK: Apex 路線預備
顯示隱藏 Apex 所需的遠征旗標缺口。
en: Reveals missing expedition flags required by hidden Apex routes.

zh_HK: 融合終極工程
3-1 匯合：再 +4% 融合效率。不再疊相性折抵。
en: 3-1 convergence: adds 4% fusion efficiency without stacking another affinity discount.

zh_HK: 生物質回收效率
全域生存：生物質回收 +6%。回收只從生存環來。
en: Global survival: increases biomass recovery by 6%. Recovery comes only from the Survival ring.

zh_HK: 受傷修復加速
單位再生 +6%。不修核心（核心修復在防線環）。
en: Increases unit regeneration by 6%. It does not repair the Core, which belongs to the Defense ring.

zh_HK: 核心緊急修復
2-1 匯合：波次間核心一次急救。規則，不再疊核心修復%。
en: 2-1 convergence: performs one emergency Core repair between waves without stacking continuous Core repair.

zh_HK: 細胞再生儲備
擊殺儲存再生電荷。規則解鎖。
en: Stores regeneration charges on kills. Unlocks a rule.

zh_HK: 陣亡後備援
陣亡後短暫再部署一次。規則解鎖。
en: Allows one brief redeployment after a unit is defeated. Unlocks a rule.

zh_HK: 資源短缺緩解
資源見底時下一波掉落保底。
en: Guarantees a minimum drop in the next wave when resources are depleted.

zh_HK: 生存終極修復
3-1 匯合：再 +4% 單位再生。不疊生物質與核心修復。
en: 3-1 convergence: adds 4% unit regeneration without stacking biomass or Core repair.

zh_HK: 標記疊層化學
全域化學：標記最高疊層 +1，持續期間被標記目標受到額外集火權重。
en: Global chemistry: increases maximum Mark stacks by 1 and gives marked targets extra focus-fire priority during the effect.

zh_HK: 抗體弱點化學
全域化學：弱點放大 +8%。狀態環負責易傷，戰爭環負責攻速。
en: Global chemistry: increases weakness amplification by 8%. The Status ring owns vulnerability while the War ring owns attack speed.

zh_HK: 腐蝕破防化學
2-1 匯合：破甲 +8%。規則轉化，不把弱點再加一次。
en: 2-1 convergence: adds 8% armor shred through a rule conversion without applying weakness twice.

zh_HK: 緩速控制化學
受控敵人移速 −8%。與防線路線障壁分開。
en: Reduces controlled enemy movement speed by 8%. Separate from the Defense route barrier.

zh_HK: 感染擴散化學
擊殺或疊滿時，狀態可跳到鄰近敵人。
en: Allows a status to jump to a nearby enemy on a kill or at maximum stacks.

zh_HK: 鏈鎖跳躍化學
連鎖傷害與標記可額外跳一次。
en: Allows chained damage and Marks to jump one additional time.

zh_HK: 暴擊觸發化學
3-1 匯合：全域暴擊 +5%。終局給觸發率，不再疊弱點與破甲。
en: 3-1 convergence: adds 5% global critical chance without stacking more weakness or armor shred.
